name: Exterior Mirrors
description: Side mirrors – factory power mirrors or lightweight race mirrors.

components.name: Side mirrors (L & R)
components.description: Factory power/heated mirrors or lightweight fixed race mirrors. Mirrors must be secure and crack-free (SCCA). Race mirrors often mount to a door-skin plate.
components.location: Front of door windows, x ≈ 0.80, y ≈ 1.00, z ±0.98.

hardware.spec: M6 x 1.0 nut on mirror studs (GM OE)
